prompt: Build an ECS for a game with Position, Velocity, Health, Sprite, Collider, AI components and systems that process specific combinations.

assertions.name: component_storage_scalable
assertions.description: Type-erased storage (Any/TypeId), NOT Entity struct with Option<T> per component

assertions.name: system_trait
assertions.description: Systems implement a trait, extensible without modifying ECS core

assertions.name: component_queries
assertions.description: Way to query entities by component combination without knowing unrelated components

assertions.name: adding_component_isolated
assertions.description: New component type doesn't require modifying World/ECS, existing components, or systems
